read_extent: Complete 39-line adapter, complete 7-line protocol and all 117 retained recurrence source lines; 2 adapter and 9 recurrence definitions compiled only.
findings: With forward=P_node_inverse and the left callback an explicit pair copy, the retained recurrence applies A P_node_inverse to each Arnoldi basis vector and initializes from the original residual. It makes no transpose or congruence inference.

Auxiliary candidate is mapped through the right factor, then added to the original correction start. All physical candidate action/residual and delta/compression contacts use the unchanged full action. Repeated snapshots remain corrections from that supplied start, without resetting the physical base state.
Cap is explicit 1..80; original score callback returns 3x2 raw/scaled scores, and all six must pass P.LINEAR_TOL=1e-10. Arnoldi/QR/preconditioned residuals do not own physical admission.

The required containing admission must authenticate all four same-candidate caches and new active nodal factors and supply target-minus-current signed RHS, consistent cached action/residual/scores, original masks/packing and positive-envelope callback. Future closure pins remain None; this adapter supplies no release or invocation.

Native priors remain fixed while the prepared York target is geometry dependent. Outer configuration/phase/Newton terms and a fresh nonlinear action/normal/CMC readout remain containing-caller obligations; local factors do not certify a global inverse.

Historical internal adjoint/congruence labels are explicitly scoped to callback positions; the wrapper records identity-left/right-only semantics and preserves paired correction insertion/compression metadata.
